requiredCases.evidence: PluginManifestV2 strict contract: pluginId, version, packageDigest, protocolVersion=1, declaredCapabilities, unique toolSchemas, dataNamespace, executionProfileRef and lifecycle hooks; undeclared capability shapes and generic store/shell/credential/host-command capabilities reject.

PluginLeaseV1 carries pluginId, version, generation, ownerScopes, bounded activeCalls (32), registrations and STARTING|ACTIVE|DRAINING|STOPPED|FAILED|UNKNOWN; HOLD_* strings never validate as a lease state.

WorkerFrameV1 strict shape: protocolVersion=1, bounded requestId/generation, kinds HELLO|READY|REQUEST|RESPONSE|CANCEL|SHUTDOWN|BYE|ERROR over 4-byte LE length prefix + UTF-8 JSON on private host-created pipes.
A 1 MiB frame is read and schema-checked; a 1 MiB+1 announced length is rejected at the header before payload allocation; invalid UTF-8 and JSON that fails the frame schema are PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.
32 outstanding requests admitted; request 33 raises PLUGIN_BUSY with no REQUEST frame dispatched; one settlement re-admits a new request.
Malformed/oversized frames, unknown kinds, extra fields, unknown request ids, duplicate generations and non-READY handshake traffic are rejected before dispatch.

The worker activates its declared host entry inside a separate owned process and receives only frozen {dataDir, genVersion}; the real-entry test asserts the context key set and no host object crosses the pipes.

admitIsolatedPackage verifies the installed pinned directory through the existing inventory owner and binds the verified digest/protocolVersion; declaration identity must equal the verified manifest; trusted-only packages return null.
READY operations outside the manifest declaration are PROTOCOL_VIOLATION; dispatch mediates through the ACTIVE lease's tool registrations so a worker cannot self-grant or promote a hidden schema.
Extension rows flow through the existing /api/plugins catalog contract with sanitized bounded fields; the trusted PluginFrame sandbox and CSP are unchanged.
